curve forward with left 0 %, right 30 % (turns left)

control_flow: Forever: call avoidWalls, which returns after one step, then it repeats.

avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 30 % and the LEFT obstacle sensor sees something, curve right; else if LLIGHT is below 30 % and the RIGHT sensor sees something, curve left; else (LLIGHT below 30 % and neither) driveInTheDark; else (LLIGHT 30 % or more) driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the FRONT obstacle sensor sees something, stop; else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.
